description: Nikita Moskalenko and co-authors at Technische Universität Berlin and Europa-Universität Flensburg publish the input data, model code and results used in their study of European independence from Russian natural gas. The source explicitly describes effects of import restrictions on energy-system development. Three ZIP file descriptors separate inputs, the model and results. These components form one reproducibility bundle for an energy-system planning study. Zenodo makes the deposit freely available under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is Europe; the inspected metadata does not identify the full scenario horizon, country list, time aggregation, numerical variables or underlying data vintages. This limits comparison with other European GENeSYS-MOD scenario datasets. The related GENeSYS-MOD record describes the model family. No archive contents were inspected, no model was run and no reported outcome was independently verified.
